a: LEAD Summit is AMCOB's flagship annual event for founders, CEOs, and executives. LEAD Summit Anaheim takes place March 26 to 28, 2027 in Anaheim, bringing together 300 of the most motivated Muslim business leaders in the country.
LEAD Summit is designed for Muslim founders, CEOs, and senior executives who are ready to scale, connect, and build with intention.

q: Do I need to be an AMCOB member to attend?
a: No. LEAD Summit is open to all qualified professionals. AMCOB members receive exclusive discounts.

q: Is the expo open to the public?
a: No. Only registered summit attendees and credentialed press can access the expo floor.

q: Are there opportunities for women entrepreneurs?
a: Absolutely. The AMCOB LEAD Summit welcomes Muslim women founders and executives.

q: How do I become a speaker or partner?
a: Email info@amcob.org with a short note about your work and what you would bring to the room.

q: Is a LEAD Summit ticket worth it?
a: One good introduction pays for the seat many times over , plus tools and peer relationships that outlast three days in Anaheim.

As participation in LEAD is intentionally limited, cancellations are managed with care: Cancellations made on or before January 1 are eligible for a full refund. Cancellations made between January 2 and February 15 are eligible for a 50% refund. After February 15, participation is non-refundable.
